rules: Public download does not equal redistribution permission.
Do not bundle leaked Treyarch/Activision source, maps, models, textures, voices, music or ripped commercial assets.
Use commercial/original BO3 only as behavioral/visual reference from legitimately accessible material.
Prefer author-approved fan source, NZ:P GPL code, CC0 assets, or clean-room replacements.
Preserve attribution and license notices for any third-party code/assets that permit redistribution.
